title: The Five from a Peashell
summary: Five green peas sat in a green pod; they grew side by side in the warm sunshine, believing the whole universe was green....
full_text:
Five green peas sat in a green pod; they grew side by side in the warm sunshine, believing the whole universe was green.

When the pod ripened and turned yellow, a boy shot them from his pea-shooter into the wide world!

The first pea flew toward the sun; the second flew into the clouds; the third and fourth were swallowed by pigeons.

The fifth pea landed in a crack in the rotten wooden sill outside a garret window where a sick, bedridden girl lived with her poor mother.

The pea took root, shot up green leaves, and bloomed with delicate pink flowers! The sick child sat up in bed, smiled with radiant hope, and stroked the tender blossom. Daily she gained strength, nurtured by the living miracle of the growing plant, until she was completely healed.

The first four peas were lost in vanity, but the fifth pea fulfilled the divine mission of bringing life and joy to a human heart.
moral: To bring hope, health, and joy to a suffering soul is the greatest destiny in creation.
